rationale: Warmup profile: 639 receive fps versus 190 process fps, with 64% processing time in per-frame SQLite commits. A 256-frame/100ms FULL-durability batch amortizes fsync; bounded queue allows brief bursts only. Five-second queue/process and eight-second durable latency budgets are operational guardrails far below the prior 173-second failure and the frozen five-minute decision clock. A continuous all-event stream should advance within 20 seconds. No result-based threshold adjustment permitted.
